info.longName: Northern Trust Developed Markets ex-US Quality Low Volatility ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts (“ADRs”) and Global Depositary Receipts (“GDRs”) (collectively “Depositary Receipts”) based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is created and sponsored by NTI, as the index Provider.
